subject: Cross-region duplicate metering — request for relief credit
messages:
From: Aimee Wallace <aimee.wallace@aurionhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ian Cho <ian.cho@aurionhealth.com>, Aurion Health Billing <billing@aurionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected duplicate charges in May usage (possible cross-region metering)

Hi Chloe,

Hope youre well. Were reviewing our May invoice and noticed a pair of line items that look like duplicate metering for the same production traffic: one billed to the US region and one to EU (line items 4502 and 4519 on attached invoice). We recently executed a DR cutover between regions on 2026-05-03 and suspect some traffic was double-counted during the window.

Can Redwood confirm whether these were duplicate measurements and whether you can apply a retroactive relief credit? Were trying to close our month-end and need an estimate for finance.

Attachments: invoice_202605.pdf, usage_export_aurion_may.csv

Thanks,
Aimee Wallace
Director, Cloud Operations
Aurion Health
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Aimee Wallace <aimee.wallace@aurionhealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate charges in May usage (possible cross-region metering)

Thanks for the note and the attachments, Aimee. Ive looped in Logan (billing ops) and Marcus (account lead) to investigate.

Quick answers up front:
- We will triage the usage export for overlapping session IDs and KV-cache duplicates.
- If we confirm a double-count, we can propose a two-part remedy: a retroactive service credit to remove the duplicate token charges plus a goodwill concession for the disruption window.
- For EU-billed lines were going to need the VAT status / tax residency confirmation for Aurion so we can issue credits correctly and confirm reverse-charge handling if applicable.

Ile added a short checklist:
1) Wel run a cross-region dedupe on the May 3-5 window.
2) If dupes found, we produce a draft credit schedule and reference invoice(s).
3) We share credit memo and any VAT reallocation notes for your tax team.

Were on it and will get an initial read by EOD tomorrow.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Priyam Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Aurion duplicate-metering preliminary runbook

Chloe/Marcus —

I ran a quick dedupe on the runtime logs and found ~2.1M tokens duplicated across the US/EU pools between 2026-05-03T02:00:00Z and 2026-05-04T11:45:00Z. Evidence: attached usage_export_aurion_may.csv (filtered) and a pivot I prepared in credit_workflow.xlsx.

Proposal:
- Apply a retroactive token credit equal to the duplicated tokens * standard per-token rate in May (costed per the invoice).
- Add a one-time goodwill credit of 10% of the calculated token credit to compensate for ops disruption and reconciliation effort.
- For the EU-billed portion, mark the credit as net of VAT and request Aurion confirm whether they are eligible for reverse-charge; if they are, we will annotate the credit memo accordingly.

Action items:
1) Marcus to approve the dollar value (Il attach the calc tab).
2) Ben to route credit memo through billing system and generate CM-2026-078 (pending Marcus sign-off).
3) Chloe to confirm tax residency/VAT details from Aurion.

-B
Logan
Senior Billing Ops Engineer
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Aurion duplicate-metering preliminary runbook

Thanks Logan — numbers look reasonable from the quick pivot. Approve the proposed remediation: retroactive token credit + 10% goodwill concession. Please ensure the credit memo clearly references both affected invoice lines and includes the usage window.

Ben — please prepare CM-2026-078 and hold for Chloe to confirm VAT/residency before final issuance for EU portion. If Aurion confirms reverse-charge applicability, mark the EU adjustment as VAT-exempt on our side and include the TIN field on the memo.

Marcus
Director, Enterprise Accounts
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Aimee Wallace <aimee.wallace@aurionhealth.com>, Ian Cho <ian.cho@aurionhealth.com>, Aurion Health Billing <billing@aurionhealth.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-26T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Resolution: Credit memo CM-2026-078 prepared (action needed: VAT/TIN confirmation)

Hi Aimee / Ian —

Thanks for your patience. We completed the dedupe and have prepared a draft credit memo: CM-2026-078 (attached internally). Summary:
- Duplicated token volume: 2,095,420 tokens
- Retroactive token credit (net): $4,189.84
- Goodwill concession (10%): $418.98
- Total credit amount: $4,608.82

Files attached (sent to Aurion billing on request): invoice_202605.pdf (referenced), usage_export_aurion_may.csv (filtered evidence), credit_workflow.xlsx (calculation tabs).

Next steps we need from Aurion to finalize:
1) Confirm EU VAT status / provide VAT registration number (TIN) if reverse-charge applies. If youre not VAT-registered in the EU, we will include VAT as part of the credit adjustment (and issue appropriate credit notes).
2) Confirm youre happy with the total credit amount above so Ben can post CM-2026-078 and apply the balance to your account.

If we dont hear back by EOD Thursday (2026-05-28), we will post the token credit to the account as net credit and flag the EU VAT portion for follow-up with your tax team.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Account Manager, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
